verdict.rationale: The only tmux evidence is one hands-on community report that kitty works well with a zsh/tmux setup, and only "with a few tweaks" (kitty-comm-1). kitty offers its own programmable tabs, splits and layouts (kitty-docs-27), but nothing in the pack documents tmux integration or a tmux control mode. Missing for 10: first-party docs on running tmux inside kitty, a native tmux control-mode integration, details of the required tweaks, and further independent corroboration.
